text: 重磅经济数据即将发布，多领域释放积极信号 期待政策能够进一步精准施策，重点关注提振居民消费和民营投资，培育中长期动能。
text_en: Major economic data is about to be released, with positive signals in multiple areas. Expectations are for more precisely targeted policies, with focus on boosting household consumption and private investment and fostering medium- to long-term momentum.
